description: Canonical catalog-only discovery cards for the P2 discovery registry (WP-H73). Every card is admission_status="catalog_only": registry presence never implies readiness, license clearance, or a built adapter. license_declared is the upstream SPDX as declared by the project, never a clearance. The path to candidacy runs through P1 admission (WP-H70).
